newsitem.title: USA: Blyth Industries buys fragrance company.
newsitem.headline: Blyth Industries buys fragrance company.

text.p: Blyth Industries Inc said on Wednesday that it has completed the acquisition of Endar Corp, a privately held home fragrance company headquartered in Temecula, Calif.
Blyth issued 1,267,205 shares of common stock to holders of Endar's stock and warrants, in a deal valued about $45 million.
Robert Goergen, Blyth's chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement, "We expect this acquisition to be positively accretive to our earnings in this fiscal year."
Blyth, which has about 32.7 million shares outstanding, makes and markets candles and fragrance products.
